experts.description: Tool-free reviewer specialized in Amazon EKS (AWS) source-side concerns. Provides EKS-specific analysis of the Evidence Pack and produces SIGN-OFF: PASS/FAIL. Select only after the Chief Architect has posted an Evidence Pack; required only if the source platform is EKS.

Tool-free reviewer specialized in Google GKE source-side concerns. Provides GKE-specific analysis of the Evidence Pack and produces SIGN-OFF: PASS/FAIL. Select only after the Chief Architect has posted an Evidence Pack; required only if the source platform is GKE.

Tool-free reviewer for Rancher / RKE / RKE2 / K3s source-side concerns. Reviews the Evidence Pack and produces SIGN-OFF: PASS/FAIL. Select only after the Chief Architect has posted an Evidence Pack; required only if the source platform is Rancher.

Tool-free reviewer for VMware Tanzu (TKG / TKGS) source-side concerns. Reviews the Evidence Pack and produces SIGN-OFF: PASS/FAIL. Select only after the Chief Architect has posted an Evidence Pack; required only if the source platform is Tanzu.

Select only after the Chief Architect has posted an Evidence Pack; required only if the source platform is on-prem.
